words.enDefinition: A framework specifying the population, intervention, comparator, and outcomes of a clinical evidence question.

examples.en: The PICO framework separates the fictional study question into four parts on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 课堂练习用「PICO 框架」把虚构研究问题拆成四个部分。

examples.en: We used the PICO framework to compare two questions about a simulated follow-up programme.
examples.zh: 我们用「PICO 框架」比较关于模拟随访项目的两个问题。

collocations: question structured with the PICO framework

words.enDefinition: Research involving people or human data to answer a health-related question, whether observational or interventional.

examples.en: The clinical study in the textbook records changes in comfort reported during the fictional follow-up period.
examples.zh: 教材里的「临床研究」记录虚构随访期间参与者报告的舒适度变化。

examples.en: We read the clinical study summary to determine whether the researchers assigned anything to participants.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「临床研究」摘要，确认研究者是否为参与者分配了某种干预。

words.enDefinition: A study that prospectively assigns people to one or more interventions to evaluate health-related outcomes.

examples.en: The fictional clinical trial compares two diary formats using a simulated outcome about activity reporting.
examples.zh: 虚构「临床试验」用一项模拟的活动记录结局比较两种日志版式。

examples.en: We identified the clinical trial because the study assigned an intervention and evaluated a health outcome.
examples.zh: 这项研究分配了干预并评估健康结局，因此我们判断它属于「临床试验」。

words.enDefinition: A study in which researchers record exposures and outcomes without assigning the exposure or intervention.

examples.en: The observational study records participants' usual activities and their responses on the fictional well-being questionnaire.
examples.zh: 「观察性研究」记录参与者的日常活动和他们在虚构身心状态问卷上的回答。

examples.en: We labelled the example an observational study because the report describes activities that participants chose themselves.
examples.zh: 报告描述的是参与者自己选择的活动，因此我们把示例标为「观察性研究」。

words.enDefinition: An observational design that examines outcomes over time in a defined group, often across exposure categories.

examples.en: The cohort study follows the same group through several fictional assessments of daily activity and comfort.
examples.zh: 「队列研究」跟踪同一组参与者，进行数次虚构的日常活动和舒适度评估。

examples.en: We identified when follow-up began for each group in the classroom cohort study diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂「队列研究」图上确定各组开始随访的时间。

words.enDefinition: A cohort study that defines its group and records outcomes as they occur after the study starts.

examples.en: The prospective cohort study records questionnaire responses after the fictional participants enter the study group.
examples.zh: 「前瞻性队列研究」在虚构参与者进入研究群组后记录其问卷回答。

examples.en: We drew a timeline for the prospective cohort study to show when follow-up observations begin.
examples.zh: 我们为「前瞻性队列研究」画出时间线，标明何时开始记录随访观察结果。

collocations: outcomes of a prospective cohort study
results from a prospective cohort study

words.enDefinition: A cohort study that reconstructs group membership, exposures, and later outcomes from records available at study initiation.

examples.en: The retrospective cohort study uses fictional records that already contain dates for activities and later outcomes.
examples.zh: 「回顾性队列研究」采用已记录活动和后续结局日期的虚构资料。

examples.en: We compared the starting date of the retrospective cohort study with the dates in its records.
examples.zh: 我们将「回顾性队列研究」的启动日期与其中的记录日期作了比较。

collocations: records for a retrospective cohort study
evidence from a retrospective cohort study

words.enDefinition: An observational design that samples people with and without the outcome of interest and compares their prior exposures.

examples.en: The case-control study compares previously recorded activity patterns among fictional participants with different outcome statuses.
examples.zh: 「病例对照研究」比较不同结局状态的虚构参与者先前记录的活动模式。

examples.en: We labelled the outcome groups first when reading the case-control study diagram in our workbook.
examples.zh: 我们阅读练习册上的「病例对照研究」图时，先标出各结局组。

words.enDefinition: A case-control study whose cases and controls are drawn from an established cohort.

examples.en: The nested case-control study draws both comparison groups from the same fictional cohort in the figure.
examples.zh: 图中的「巢式病例对照研究」从同一虚构队列中抽取两个比较组。

examples.en: We checked the parent cohort before interpreting the records in the nested case-control study example.
examples.zh: 解读「巢式病例对照研究」示例中的记录前，我们先核对了原队列。

collocations: parent cohort of a nested case-control study
findings from a nested case-control study

words.enDefinition: An observational study measuring characteristics and outcomes at one time or over a short defined period.

examples.en: The cross-sectional study reports fictional comfort scores and activity categories measured during the same survey week.
examples.zh: 「横断面研究」报告在同一调查周测得的虚构舒适度评分和活动类别。

examples.en: We read the cross-sectional study summary to see which measures were recorded at the same time.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「横断面研究」摘要，确认哪些指标是在同一时间记录的。

words.enDefinition: An observational design that compares aggregate characteristics and outcomes across groups, places, or time periods.

examples.en: The ecological study compares district averages from a synthetic dataset about walking and reported daily comfort.
examples.zh: 「生态学研究」使用步行与自报日常舒适度的合成数据，对比地区均值。

examples.en: We checked that the ecological study table reports one row per district in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们核对课堂示例里「生态学研究」的表格确实按地区逐行列出。

words.enDefinition: An error that infers an individual relationship from an association measured for groups.

examples.en: The exercise illustrates the ecological fallacy by contrasting the district pattern with the fictional individual records.
examples.zh: 练习通过对比地区层面的模式与虚构个体记录，说明「生态学谬误」。

examples.en: We discussed the ecological fallacy before using district averages to interpret the synthetic chart in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先讨论「生态学谬误」，再用地区均值解读合成图表。

words.enDefinition: A detailed account of the observations and course of one individual case.

examples.en: The case report follows one fictional participant's activity scores across the visits described in the article.
examples.zh: 「病例报告」记录一名虚构参与者在文中所述各次访视中的活动评分。

examples.en: We checked the timeline in the case report before discussing the limits of the observation.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「病例报告」中的时间线，再讨论该观察的局限。

words.enDefinition: A description of observations in several cases grouped by a shared characteristic, usually without a formal comparator.

examples.en: The case series describes several fictional participants who share the same activity pattern in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 「病例系列」描述了练习中活动模式相同的几名虚构参与者。

examples.en: We identified the case series by the way the report grouped individual accounts with similar features.
examples.zh: 我们依据报告把具有相似特征的个体叙述归组的方式，辨认出「病例系列」。

words.enDefinition: A study describing how a health condition or characteristic evolves over time without the study assigning an intervention.

examples.en: The natural history study tracks changing comfort scores in a fictional follow-up table over several visits.
examples.zh: 「自然病程研究」在虚构随访表中追踪数次访视期间舒适度评分的变化。

examples.en: We read the natural history study to learn how the modelled condition changed during observation.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「自然病程研究」，了解模型中的状况在观察期间如何变化。

collocations: observations in a natural history study
follow-up in a natural history study

words.enDefinition: A study that uses data from an organized register of people or events defined by shared criteria.

examples.en: The registry-based study uses a fictional register that groups records by agreed categories in the example.
examples.zh: 示例的「基于登记库的研究」使用按约定类别整理记录的虚构登记库。

examples.en: We read the coverage notes for the registry-based study before interpreting the follow-up table in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先读「基于登记库的研究」的覆盖范围说明，再解读随访表。

words.enDefinition: A trial assigning participants or groups by chance to intervention and comparison conditions.

examples.en: The randomised controlled trial in the worksheet compares two formats for a fictional activity diary.
examples.zh: 练习里的「随机对照试验」比较虚构活动日志的两种格式。

examples.en: We checked how the randomised controlled trial describes its comparison groups in the methods summary.
examples.zh: 我们核对「随机对照试验」在方法摘要中如何描述比较组。

collocations: evidence from a randomised controlled trial

words.enDefinition: A trial in which comparison groups follow their assigned interventions during the same overall study period.

examples.en: In the parallel-group trial, each fictional group follows one assigned diary format throughout the observation period.
examples.zh: 在「平行组试验」中，各虚构组在整个观察期内沿用各自分配的日志格式。

examples.en: We read the parallel-group trial diagram to identify the groups observed over the same period.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「平行组试验」图，找出在同一时段接受观察的各组。

words.enDefinition: A trial in which each participant receives more than one intervention in different periods, commonly in an assigned order.

examples.en: The crossover trial compares two fictional questionnaire layouts across two periods for the same participants.
examples.zh: 「交叉试验」让同一批参与者在两个时段比较两种虚构问卷版式。

examples.en: We checked the order of the formats in the classroom diagram of the crossover trial.
examples.zh: 我们核对课堂「交叉试验」图中使用不同版式的顺序。

collocations: study periods in a crossover trial

words.enDefinition: A trial that randomly assigns groups of people, rather than individual people, to study interventions.

examples.en: The cluster-randomised trial assigns fictional classrooms to diary formats rather than assigning the students individually.
examples.zh: 「整群随机试验」以虚构班级为单位分配日志格式。

examples.en: We identified the unit of assignment in the classroom summary of the cluster-randomised trial report.
examples.zh: 我们在「整群随机试验」报告的课堂摘要中找出分配单位。

words.enDefinition: A trial comparing combinations of levels of two or more intervention factors.

examples.en: The factorial trial table lists combinations of reminder timing and diary format in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 虚构示例的「析因试验」表列出提醒时间与日志格式的不同组合。

examples.en: We read across the factorial trial table to see which groups share the same format.
examples.zh: 我们逐项查看「析因试验」表，找出使用同一版式的组。

words.enDefinition: A trial designed to assess an intervention under conditions relevant to usual practice and routine decisions.

examples.en: The pragmatic trial example reports observations collected during routine visits at the fictional study sites.
examples.zh: 「实用性试验」示例报告在虚构研究场所日常访视中收集的观察结果。

examples.en: We examined the setting of the pragmatic trial when discussing whether its findings would apply elsewhere.
examples.zh: 讨论结果能否用于其他场合时，我们查看了「实用性试验」的实施环境。

words.enDefinition: A trial designed to test an intervention's effect under closely specified and relatively controlled conditions.

examples.en: The explanatory trial describes the conditions for the fictional comparison in more detail than the routine records.
examples.zh: 与常规记录相比，「解释性试验」更详细地描述了虚构比较所用的条件。

examples.en: We compared the explanatory trial setting with the routine follow-up described elsewhere in the workbook.
examples.zh: 我们将「解释性试验」的环境与练习册其他部分所述的常规随访作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A small preliminary trial that rehearses aspects of a planned larger trial and examines feasibility.

examples.en: The pilot trial summary focuses on whether the fictional participants could complete the planned follow-up visits.
examples.zh: 「先导试验」摘要着重考察虚构参与者是否能按计划完成随访。

examples.en: We checked which feasibility questions the pilot trial answered before reading its exploratory outcome table.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「先导试验」回答了哪些可行性问题，再看其探索性结局表。

collocations: feasibility results from a pilot trial

words.enDefinition: A group of participants assigned to a particular intervention or comparison condition in a clinical trial.

examples.en: The trial arm in the first column is assigned a different reminder format in the fictional report.
examples.zh: 在虚构报告中，第一列的「试验组」被分配了一种不同的提醒格式。

examples.en: We followed each trial arm from assignment to the last observation in the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上追踪各「试验组」从分配到末次观测的全过程。

words.enDefinition: A comparison intervention expected to have an active effect in the study's setting.

examples.en: The active comparator is a different reminder format already used in the fictional study setting.
examples.zh: 「活性对照」是虚构研究场景中已经使用的另一种提醒格式。

examples.en: We identified the active comparator by reading the description of the second group in the report.
examples.zh: 我们阅读报告对第二组的描述，找出「活性对照」。

words.enDefinition: A comparison condition in which participants continue to receive the care ordinarily available in that setting.

examples.en: The usual-care control group receives the routine follow-up described in the fictional study summary for the class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构研究摘要中，「常规照护对照」组接受所述的日常随访。

examples.en: We checked what the report included under usual-care control before comparing the outcomes in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先确认报告将哪些项目归入「常规照护对照」，再对比结局。

words.enDefinition: A comparison condition designed to resemble the intervention experience without its specific active component.

examples.en: The placebo control is described separately in the teaching table on how comparison groups are reported.
examples.zh: 有关比较组报告方式的教学表单独描述了「安慰剂对照」。

examples.en: We identified the placebo control from the terminology in the fictional trial summary for class.
examples.zh: 我们根据课堂虚构试验摘要中的术语辨认出「安慰剂对照」。

words.enDefinition: A comparison group observed in an earlier period than the group receiving the intervention in a study.

examples.en: The historical control in the report comes from an earlier round of fictional follow-up records.
examples.zh: 报告中的「历史对照」来自较早一轮虚构随访记录。

examples.en: We discussed changes over time when interpreting the historical control in the classroom study table.
examples.zh: 解读课堂研究表中的「历史对照」时，我们讨论了随时间发生的变化。

words.enDefinition: A comparison group observed during the same period as the group under study.

examples.en: The concurrent control completed its final questionnaire during the same week as the other fictional group.
examples.zh: 「同期对照」组在与另一虚构组相同的一周内完成了最终问卷。

examples.en: We identified the concurrent control by comparing the dates in the classroom participant flow chart.
examples.zh: 我们对照课堂参与者流程图上的日期，找出「同期对照」。

words.enDefinition: Keeping upcoming assignments from those enrolling participants until the moment each assignment is made.

examples.en: The report discusses allocation concealment separately from whether participants knew their groups after assignment in class.
examples.zh: 课堂报告分别讨论「分配隐藏」和参与者分配后是否知道自己所在组别。

examples.en: We read the allocation concealment statement before reviewing how the fictional trial describes its recruitment.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读「分配隐藏」说明，再查看虚构试验对招募的描述。

words.enDefinition: Keeping participants unaware of their assigned study intervention or group after allocation.

examples.en: The report states whether participant blinding was maintained throughout the fictional study's follow-up period.
examples.zh: 报告说明在虚构研究的整个随访期间是否维持了「参与者设盲」。

examples.en: We looked for participant blinding in the methods summary before discussing the self-reported outcomes.
examples.zh: 我们先在方法摘要中查找「参与者设盲」说明，再讨论自报结局。

words.enDefinition: Keeping people who measure or rate outcomes unaware of participants' assigned study groups.

examples.en: The report describes outcome assessor blinding for the people who rated the fictional activity records.
examples.zh: 报告说明对虚构活动记录评分的人员是否实行了「结局评估者设盲」。

examples.en: We checked outcome assessor blinding before comparing the two columns of ratings in the classroom summary.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「结局评估者设盲」，再比较课堂摘要中的两列评分。

words.enDefinition: A trial in which participants and those delivering the interventions know the assignments.

examples.en: The open-label trial states that both fictional participants and programme staff knew the assigned diary format.
examples.zh: 「开放标签试验」明确说明，虚构参与者和项目人员都知道分配的日志版式。

examples.en: We checked whether outcomes were measured separately when reading the simulated open-label trial report in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们读模拟「开放标签试验」报告时，核对结局是否另由评估者独立测量。

words.enDefinition: A precisely defined outcome, often including what is measured and when it is evaluated in a study.

examples.en: The study endpoint is the completion of a fictional activity diary by the last recorded visit.
examples.zh: 「研究终点」是在最后一次记录的访视前完成虚构活动日志。

examples.en: We read the study endpoint definition before comparing the numbers reported for the two groups.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读「研究终点」的定义，再比较报告的两组数值。

words.enDefinition: The outcome designated as the main one for answering a study question.

examples.en: The primary outcome concerns completion of the fictional follow-up questionnaire at the stated assessment time.
examples.zh: 「主要结局」关注是否在指定评估时点完成虚构随访问卷。

examples.en: We found the primary outcome in the protocol summary before opening the simulated results table.
examples.zh: 我们先在方案摘要中找到「主要结局」，再打开模拟结果表。

words.enDefinition: An additional outcome identified in a study alongside the main outcome.

examples.en: The secondary outcome records how participants described the clarity of the fictional questionnaire in class.
examples.zh: 「次要结局」记录参与者如何描述课堂虚构问卷的清晰度。

examples.en: We compared the secondary outcome with the main outcome listed at the top of the table.
examples.zh: 我们把「次要结局」与表格顶部列出的主要结局作了比较。

words.enDefinition: An outcome examined to generate questions or hypotheses rather than to support the main confirmatory conclusion.

examples.en: The exploratory outcome concerns a change in a fictional rating that the study discusses cautiously.
examples.zh: 「探索性结局」涉及一项虚构评分的变化，研究对它的讨论很谨慎。

examples.en: We kept the exploratory outcome separate when summarising the planned comparison in the classroom report.
examples.zh: 我们在总结课堂报告的预定比较时，将「探索性结局」单独列出。

words.enDefinition: A single endpoint combining two or more specified component events or outcomes.

examples.en: The composite endpoint combines two events in the fictional table and presents them as one result.
examples.zh: 「复合终点」将虚构表中的两项事件合在一起，作为一个结果报告。

examples.en: We checked the components of the composite endpoint to see which event occurred most often.
examples.zh: 我们核对「复合终点」的各组成项，查看哪项事件出现得最多。

words.enDefinition: A measure used in place of a direct outcome, with an intended relationship to that outcome.

examples.en: The surrogate endpoint is a model measurement used in place of a later fictional functioning outcome.
examples.zh: 「替代终点」是代替虚构后续功能结局的一项模型测量值。

examples.en: We checked whether the report explained the relationship between the surrogate endpoint and everyday function.
examples.zh: 我们查看报告是否解释了「替代终点」和日常功能之间的关系。

words.enDefinition: An assessment of health status that comes directly from a patient's report without another person's interpretation.

examples.en: The patient-reported outcome comes directly from the fictional participant's answers about comfort during everyday activity.
examples.zh: 「患者报告结局」直接来自虚构参与者对日常活动舒适度问题的回答。

examples.en: We distinguished the patient-reported outcome from the rating assigned by another person in the example.
examples.zh: 我们在示例中区分「患者报告结局」与他人给出的评分。

words.enDefinition: A health outcome that directly matters to patients, such as function, symptoms, or quality of life.

examples.en: The classroom review identifies everyday functioning as a patient-important outcome in its fictional example table.
examples.zh: 课堂综述在虚构示例表中把日常功能列为「患者重视的结局」。

examples.en: We discussed why asking about daily comfort could capture a patient-important outcome in this model.
examples.zh: 我们讨论为什么询问日常舒适度能在这个模型中反映「患者重视的结局」。

words.enDefinition: The effects of health on physical, mental, and social aspects of a person's perceived daily life.

examples.en: Health-related quality of life is represented by several questionnaire domains in the fictional follow-up table.
examples.zh: 虚构随访表用问卷的多个领域表示「健康相关生活质量」。

examples.en: We compared two health-related quality of life scores measured at different times in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂示例在不同时点测得的两个「健康相关生活质量」评分。

collocations: change in health-related quality of life

words.enDefinition: The difference between a follow-up measurement and the corresponding starting measurement for a participant or group.

examples.en: The change from baseline is calculated by subtracting each fictional starting score from its follow-up score.
examples.zh: 「较基线的变化」用每名虚构参与者的随访评分减去其起始评分来计算。

examples.en: We checked the scoring direction before interpreting change from baseline in the classroom comparison table.
examples.zh: 我们先核对评分方向，再解读课堂对照表中的「较基线的变化」。

words.enDefinition: A table describing the study groups at the start using relevant measured participant characteristics.

examples.en: The baseline characteristics table describes the fictional participants before their follow-up records are summarised in class.
examples.zh: 课堂「基线特征表」描述虚构参与者的起始特征，后面才汇总其随访记录。

examples.en: We read the baseline characteristics table to understand who was included in each study group.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「基线特征表」，了解各研究组纳入的是哪些人。

collocations: variables in a baseline characteristics table
group summaries in a baseline characteristics table

words.enDefinition: A specified time at which an outcome or other study measurement is recorded.

examples.en: The assessment time point for the outcome is marked at the end of the fictional calendar.
examples.zh: 结局的「评估时点」标在虚构日程的末尾。

examples.en: We checked the assessment time point because the two classroom tables describe different follow-up visits.
examples.zh: 我们核对「评估时点」，因为两张课堂表描述的是不同的随访时点。

words.enDefinition: The interval during which participants or their records are observed for study outcomes after a defined starting point.

examples.en: The follow-up period is shown as a shaded interval on the classroom chart of fictional visits.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构访视图用阴影时段表示「随访期」。

examples.en: We compared two studies with different follow-up period lengths in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中比较两项「随访期」长短不同的研究。

words.enDefinition: The loss of outcome information when enrolled participants can no longer be contacted or observed as planned.

examples.en: The figure reports loss to follow-up for each group in the fictional participant records after enrolment.
examples.zh: 图中报告了虚构参与者入组后各组记录的「失访」。

examples.en: We examined loss to follow-up before deciding how to interpret the remaining classroom records.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「失访」情况，再决定如何解读剩余课堂记录。

words.enDefinition: The sum of time that individuals contribute while being observed and eligible to experience an event.

examples.en: Person-time combines the differing observation lengths of all eligible fictional participants in the classroom table.
examples.zh: 「人时」将课堂表中所有符合条件的虚构参与者各自不同的观察时长加总。

examples.en: We checked how person-time was counted after several people stopped contributing observations in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中有几人不再贡献观测数据后，我们核对「人时」的计算方式。

words.enDefinition: A unit equivalent to one person contributing one year of observation time.

examples.en: The table uses a person-year as the unit for combined observation time in the fictional study.
examples.zh: 虚构研究的表格用「人年」作为合计观察时长的单位。

examples.en: We converted shorter observation periods to a fraction of a person-year in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习将短于一年的观测时段换算为「人年」的相应分数。

words.enDefinition: The people eligible to experience the event being counted during a defined interval or at its start.

examples.en: The population at risk includes only people eligible for a first recorded event in the fictional table.
examples.zh: 虚构表的「处于风险中的人群」只包括可能首次出现所计事件的人。

examples.en: We identified the population at risk before dividing the event count by the appropriate denominator.
examples.zh: 我们先确定「处于风险中的人群」，再将事件数除以相应分母。

collocations: size of the population at risk

words.enDefinition: The fraction of an initially event-free population that experiences the defined event within a specified period.

examples.en: The incidence proportion counts people with a first event out of those initially eligible in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，「累积发生比例」用首次出现所计事件的人数除以起初符合条件的人数。

examples.en: We wrote the time interval beside the incidence proportion on the synthetic results table.
examples.zh: 我们在合成结果表的「累积发生比例」旁写明所用时段。

words.enDefinition: The number of new events divided by the person-time at risk over the specified observation period.

examples.en: The incidence rate is expressed per unit of person-time in the synthetic classroom study table.
examples.zh: 课堂合成研究表中的「发生率」按单位人时表示。

examples.en: We calculated the incidence rate using only the time each fictional person was still at risk.
examples.zh: 我们仅使用各虚构人物处于风险中的时间计算「发生率」。

words.enDefinition: The proportion of a population with a defined condition or characteristic at a specified instant.

examples.en: The point prevalence counts people with the fictional characteristic on one named date in the table.
examples.zh: 表格中，「时点患病率」计算指定日期具有该虚构特征的人所占比例。

examples.en: We selected the same date for both groups before comparing point prevalence in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习中，我们先为两组选定同一日期，再比较「时点患病率」。

collocations: point prevalence on a specified date

words.enDefinition: The proportion of a defined population that had a condition at any time during a specified interval.

examples.en: The period prevalence counts participants who had the fictional characteristic at any time during the interval.
examples.zh: 「期间患病率」计入在所定时段任何时候具有该虚构特征的参与者。

examples.en: We checked how the population was defined before comparing period prevalence between the two classroom tables.
examples.zh: 我们先核对总体的定义，再比较两张课堂表中的「期间患病率」。

collocations: period prevalence over a defined interval

words.enDefinition: An overall rate calculated directly for a population without adjustment for differences in its composition.

examples.en: The crude rate uses the combined records for every age group in the fictional classroom population.
examples.zh: 「粗率」使用课堂虚构总体各年龄组的合计记录。

examples.en: We compared the crude rate with the adjusted figure in the next column of the table.
examples.zh: 我们将「粗率」和表格下一列的调整后数值作比较。

words.enDefinition: The rate computed for people within a specified age group.

examples.en: The age-specific rate uses only the relevant age band's event counts and observation time in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「年龄别率」只用对应年龄段的事件数和观察时长计算。

examples.en: We compared each age-specific rate before reading the combined rate for the fictional population as a whole.
examples.zh: 我们先比较各「年龄别率」，再读取整个虚构总体的合计率。

words.enDefinition: A rate adjusted for age composition so populations can be compared on a common age basis.

examples.en: The age-standardised rate uses a common age distribution for comparing the two synthetic populations in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「年龄标准化率」使用同一年龄分布比较两个合成总体。

examples.en: We checked which reference population was used before comparing the age-standardised rate across classroom tables.
examples.zh: 我们先核对采用的参考总体，再比较课堂各表中的「年龄标准化率」。

collocations: reference population for an age-standardised rate

words.enDefinition: The probability that an individual in a defined group experiences a specified event over a stated period.

examples.en: The absolute risk is given separately for each group in the fictional follow-up results table.
examples.zh: 虚构随访结果表为各组分别给出「绝对风险」。

examples.en: We recorded the time period alongside the absolute risk before comparing the classroom outcomes.
examples.zh: 我们先在「绝对风险」旁记下时段，再比较课堂结局。

collocations: absolute risk over a specified period

words.enDefinition: The risk of an event in one group divided by the risk in a comparison group over the same period.

examples.en: The risk ratio compares two fictional event proportions measured over the same follow-up interval in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「风险比」比较在同一随访时段测得的两个虚构事件比例。

examples.en: We checked the reference group before interpreting a risk ratio greater than one in the table.
examples.zh: 我们先核对参照组，再解读表中一个大于一的「风险比」。

collocations: confidence interval for a risk ratio

words.enDefinition: The odds of an outcome in one group divided by the odds in the comparison group.

examples.en: The odds ratio is based on the ratio of events to nonevents within each fictional group.
examples.zh: 「比值比」以各虚构组内事件数与非事件数之比为计算依据。

examples.en: We checked whether the table reports an odds ratio before describing the group comparison in words.
examples.zh: 我们先确认表格是否报告「比值比」，再用文字描述组间比较。

collocations: confidence interval for an odds ratio

words.enDefinition: The difference between the event probabilities of two groups over the same defined period.

examples.en: The risk difference is expressed in percentage points in the classroom table of synthetic event proportions.
examples.zh: 课堂合成事件比例表用百分点表示「风险差」。

examples.en: We calculated the risk difference by subtracting the comparison group's proportion from the first group's proportion.
examples.zh: 我们用第一组的比例减去比较组的比例，计算「风险差」。

collocations: confidence interval for a risk difference

words.enDefinition: A decrease in risk expressed as a fraction of the comparison group's risk, equal to one minus the risk ratio.

examples.en: The relative risk reduction uses the comparison group's risk as the reference in the synthetic table.
examples.zh: 合成表中的「相对风险降低」以比较组的风险为参照。

examples.en: We compared relative risk reduction with the difference in percentage points shown on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把「相对风险降低」与练习纸上的百分点差异作比较。

words.enDefinition: One event rate divided by another rate measured using a comparable person-time basis.

examples.en: The rate ratio compares two rates expressed per person-year in the fictional teaching table.
examples.zh: 虚构教学表里的「率比」比较两个按人年表示的事件发生率。

examples.en: We located the denominator for each rate before interpreting the rate ratio in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习中，我们先找出各率的分母，再解释「率比」。

collocations: confidence interval for a rate ratio

words.enDefinition: A ratio comparing the instantaneous event rates of two groups among people who have not yet experienced the event.

examples.en: The fictional model reports a constant hazard ratio because it assumes proportional hazards throughout the follow-up period.
examples.zh: 虚构模型假设整个随访期内两组瞬时风险成比例，所以报告一个恒定的「瞬时风险比」。

examples.en: We checked the model assumptions before interpreting the hazard ratio shown in the simulated results.
examples.zh: 我们先核对模型假设，再解释模拟结果中显示的「瞬时风险比」。

words.enDefinition: Follow-up that ends while the event has not been observed, leaving its later occurrence time unknown.

examples.en: The diagram marks right-censored follow-up when the fictional record ends before any event is observed.
examples.zh: 虚构记录在观测到事件之前就已结束时，图中标为「右删失随访」。

examples.en: We distinguished right-censored follow-up from an event recorded at the final visit in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「右删失随访」与末次访视记录到事件的情况区分开。

words.enDefinition: A step curve estimating the probability of remaining event-free over time while accounting for right-censoring under stated assumptions.

examples.en: The Kaplan-Meier curve remains flat between the recorded events in the synthetic time-to-event illustration.
examples.zh: 在合成事件时间图示中，「卡普兰—迈耶曲线」在两次记录事件之间保持水平。

examples.en: We checked the numbers still under observation before interpreting the end of the Kaplan-Meier curve.
examples.zh: 我们先核对仍在观察的人数，再解读「卡普兰—迈耶曲线」末端。

collocations: censoring marks on a Kaplan-Meier curve

words.enDefinition: An estimate of how many people would need the intervention for one additional beneficial outcome relative to a comparison group over a stated period.

examples.en: The number needed to treat is presented as an illustrative estimate in the fictional evidence table.
examples.zh: 「需治疗人数」作为示范性估计值列在虚构证据表中。

examples.en: We recorded the stated follow-up period alongside the number needed to treat in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示例中，将给定的随访期记录在「需治疗人数」旁。

collocations: calculate the number needed to treat
number needed to treat over a stated period
interpret the number needed to treat

words.enDefinition: The structured process of bringing together findings from several studies to answer a question.

examples.en: The evidence synthesis compares findings across the fictional follow-up studies listed in the classroom table.
examples.zh: 「证据综合」比较课堂表上所列各项虚构随访研究的发现。

examples.en: We read the evidence synthesis before discussing why the individual studies might reach different conclusions.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读「证据综合」，再讨论各项研究为何可能得出不同结论。

words.enDefinition: A review that uses explicit, prespecified methods to find, select, appraise, and synthesize eligible studies.

examples.en: The systematic review states its eligibility criteria before summarising the fictional studies in the textbook.
examples.zh: 「系统综述」先说明纳入标准，再汇总教材里的虚构研究。

examples.en: We examined the systematic review methods to see how the authors selected the evidence in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们查看「系统综述」的方法，了解作者怎样选择证据。

words.enDefinition: A review that systematically maps the types, concepts, and coverage of evidence in a broad area.

examples.en: The scoping review maps the kinds of activity measures reported across the fictional studies in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「范围综述」梳理各项虚构研究报告了哪些类型的活动指标。

examples.en: We read the scoping review to identify areas with little research in the textbook example.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「范围综述」，找出教材示例中研究较少的领域。

collocations: evidence map from a scoping review

words.enDefinition: A synthesis that uses existing systematic reviews as its main units of inclusion.

examples.en: The overview of reviews compares conclusions from three fictional systematic reviews in the classroom summary.
examples.zh: 课堂摘要的「综述的综述」比较三篇虚构系统综述所得出的结论。

examples.en: We checked whether the same study appeared in several sources within the overview of reviews.
examples.zh: 我们核查「综述的综述」的多个来源中有没有重复出现同一项研究。

collocations: overlap in an overview of reviews
evidence from an overview of reviews

words.enDefinition: A systematic review updated as relevant new evidence becomes available under an ongoing update plan.

examples.en: The living systematic review has an update date beside each new fictional entry in the table.
examples.zh: 「持续更新的系统综述」的表格在每项新加入的虚构条目旁标有更新日期。

examples.en: We compared two versions of the living systematic review to see which findings had changed.
examples.zh: 我们比较「持续更新的系统综述」的两个版本，查看哪些发现发生变化。

collocations: version of a living systematic review

words.enDefinition: An evidence review that streamlines selected review methods to produce a timely synthesis and reports the shortcuts.

examples.en: The rapid review states which review steps were shortened in the fictional methods table for class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构方法表里的「快速综述」说明缩减了哪些综述环节。

examples.en: We discussed how the chosen limits affect the rapid review in the example summary.
examples.zh: 我们讨论选定的限制怎样影响示例摘要中的「快速综述」。

words.enDefinition: A structured synthesis that explains patterns across studies mainly through text, with optional tables or other displays.

examples.en: The narrative synthesis summarises the contrasting patterns in the fictional studies in two short paragraphs.
examples.zh: 「叙述性综合」用两小段文字概括各虚构研究之间的差异。

examples.en: We read the narrative synthesis to compare which findings agree across the simulated studies in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们阅读「叙述性综合」，查看哪些发现在模拟研究之间一致。

words.enDefinition: The statistical combination of compatible results from two or more studies.

examples.en: The meta-analysis combines estimates measuring the same outcome from several fictional studies in the example.
examples.zh: 示例的「荟萃分析」合并数项虚构研究对同一结局的估计值。

examples.en: We checked whether the meta-analysis used comparable estimates before interpreting its classroom plot.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「荟萃分析」所用估计值是否可比，再解读课堂图。

words.enDefinition: A framework ranking evidence sources by their typical usefulness for a defined type of question.

examples.en: The evidence hierarchy shown in class ranks study designs for a specified question about intervention effects.
examples.zh: 课堂所示「证据层级」针对一个给定的干预效应问题，对研究设计进行分级。

examples.en: We discussed why the evidence hierarchy might look different for another kind of clinical question.
examples.zh: 我们讨论针对另一种临床问题时，「证据层级」为何可能有所不同。

collocations: evidence hierarchy for a research question

words.enDefinition: Confidence that the body of evidence supports an estimated effect or answer within a specified question.

examples.en: The certainty of evidence is shown beside each fictional outcome in the classroom review table.
examples.zh: 课堂综述表在每项虚构结局旁标出「证据确定性」。

examples.en: We compared certainty of evidence across outcomes after reading the reasons for each rating in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先读各评级的原因，再比较不同结局的「证据确定性」。

words.enDefinition: A structured framework for judging certainty of evidence and, in guideline settings, the strength of recommendations.

examples.en: The GRADE approach is used to label evidence certainty for each fictional outcome in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用「GRADE 评估方法」标明各虚构结局的证据确定性。

examples.en: We looked at the GRADE approach notes to understand why one model outcome was rated lower.
examples.zh: 我们查看「GRADE 评估方法」说明，了解为何某项模型结局的评级较低。

collocations: certainty rating with the GRADE approach

words.enDefinition: A structured review table presenting key outcomes, effect estimates, and certainty judgments for a comparison.

examples.en: The summary of findings table lists each fictional outcome alongside its effect estimate and certainty rating.
examples.zh: 「证据概要表」把各虚构结局与对应的效应估计及确定性评级并列展示。

examples.en: We used the summary of findings table to compare outcomes measured at the same follow-up time.
examples.zh: 我们用「证据概要表」比较在同一随访时点测量的结局。

collocations: read a summary of findings table
prepare a summary of findings table
interpret a summary of findings table

words.enDefinition: An appraisal of whether a study's methods or conduct could systematically distort a specified result.

examples.en: The risk of bias assessment links each judgement to a feature of the fictional study report.
examples.zh: 「偏倚风险评估」将每项判断与虚构研究报告中的一处特征相联系。

examples.en: We read the risk of bias assessment before comparing the estimates from the modelled studies.
examples.zh: 我们先读「偏倚风险评估」，再比较模型研究给出的估计值。

collocations: conduct a risk of bias assessment
document a risk of bias assessment
domain of a risk of bias assessment

words.enDefinition: Confounding in an observational comparison when the reason for giving an intervention also predicts the outcome.

examples.en: The fictional review discusses confounding by indication because starting characteristics influenced both support and later scores.
examples.zh: 虚构综述讨论「适应证混杂」，因为起始特征同时影响是否获得支持以及后续评分。

examples.en: We marked confounding by indication as a limitation when reading the example observational study in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们阅读观察性研究示例时，将「适应证混杂」标为一项局限。

words.enDefinition: Systematic differences in the accuracy or completeness of past information recalled by comparison groups.

examples.en: Recall bias is possible if the fictional groups remember past activities differently in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 课堂案例中，如果虚构各组回忆过去活动的方式不同，就可能出现「回忆偏倚」。

examples.en: We considered recall bias when comparing retrospectively reported activities with the records in the example.
examples.zh: 将回顾性报告的活动与示例记录相比较时，我们考虑了「回忆偏倚」。

words.enDefinition: Systematic distortion caused by differences between groups in how outcomes are measured or detected.

examples.en: The fictional report discusses detection bias because one group had more opportunities for outcomes to be recorded.
examples.zh: 虚构报告讨论「检出偏倚」，因为其中一组的结局得到记录的机会更多。

examples.en: We considered detection bias before interpreting the different numbers of recorded events in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们先考虑「检出偏倚」，再解读练习纸上记录的不同事件数。

words.enDefinition: Systematic distortion arising when missing or incomplete follow-up information affects the comparison of outcomes.

examples.en: The fictional review considers attrition bias after many records were missing from one follow-up group.
examples.zh: 虚构综述发现一个随访组缺失许多记录后，对「失访偏倚」进行了考虑。

examples.en: We read the reasons for missing observations before describing the risk of attrition bias in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先读观测缺失的原因，再描述「失访偏倚」风险。

words.enDefinition: Incorrect assignment of observations to exposure categories in a study.

examples.en: Exposure misclassification is possible when a fictional record places activities in the wrong category on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中的虚构记录把活动归错类时，就可能发生「暴露误分类」。

examples.en: We compared the two exposure definitions before discussing exposure misclassification in the synthetic classroom study.
examples.zh: 我们先比较两种暴露定义，再讨论课堂合成研究中的「暴露误分类」。

words.enDefinition: Distortion that occurs when whether studies are published depends on the nature or direction of their results.

examples.en: The classroom review discusses publication bias because studies with certain results might be absent from the literature.
examples.zh: 课堂综述讨论「发表偏倚」，因为具有某些结果的研究可能没有出现在文献中。

examples.en: We considered publication bias before interpreting the combined estimate from the fictional studies in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先考虑「发表偏倚」，再解读虚构研究的合并估计。

words.enDefinition: A pattern in which smaller studies tend to report systematically different effects from larger studies.

examples.en: The classroom graph suggests small-study effects because smaller fictional studies tend to report larger differences.
examples.zh: 课堂图提示「小样本研究效应」，因为样本较小的虚构研究往往报告较大的差异。

examples.en: We discussed several possible explanations for small-study effects before drawing conclusions about the simulated figure.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「小样本研究效应」的几种可能解释，再对模拟图下结论。

words.enDefinition: Differences between studies in participant populations, interventions, or outcomes.

examples.en: The clinical heterogeneity reflects different fictional participant groups and outcome definitions across the included studies.
examples.zh: 「临床异质性」反映纳入研究在虚构参与者分组和结局定义上的差别。

examples.en: We discussed clinical heterogeneity after comparing who was included in the two example studies.
examples.zh: 我们比较两项示例研究纳入的人群后，讨论了「临床异质性」。

words.enDefinition: Differences between studies in design, conduct, or methods used to measure and analyse data.

examples.en: The methodological heterogeneity comes from different study designs in the fictional evidence summary for class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构证据摘要中的「方法学异质性」源自不同的研究设计。

examples.en: We noted methodological heterogeneity while comparing how the two model studies measured their primary outcomes.
examples.zh: 我们比较两项模型研究如何测量主要结局时，记录了「方法学异质性」。

words.enDefinition: Variation among observed study effect estimates beyond what their sampling variability would alone be expected to explain.

examples.en: We discussed statistical heterogeneity after comparing the spread of the estimates with each study's uncertainty interval.
examples.zh: 我们将各估计值的离散程度与各项研究的不确定性区间作对照后，讨论了「统计异质性」。

examples.en: We examined statistical heterogeneity before deciding how to describe the combined effect in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「统计异质性」，再决定怎样描述课堂示例的合并效应。

words.enDefinition: An estimate of the percentage of variability in study effect estimates attributable to heterogeneity rather than sampling error.

examples.en: The I-squared statistic is reported beside the plot for the set of fictional studies in class.
examples.zh: 课堂将「I² 统计量」列在这组虚构研究的图旁。

examples.en: We interpreted the I-squared statistic alongside the number and precision of the included study estimates.
examples.zh: 解读「I² 统计量」时，我们同时查看所纳入研究估计值的数量和精度。

words.enDefinition: A graph showing individual study effect estimates with their uncertainty intervals, often alongside a pooled estimate.

examples.en: The forest plot displays one row per fictional study and a pooled estimate at the bottom.
examples.zh: 「森林图」给各项虚构研究各列一行，并在底部给出合并估计。

examples.en: We read the forest plot to compare the width of the intervals in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「森林图」，比较课堂示例中各区间的宽度。

collocations: study estimates in a forest plot

words.enDefinition: A graph of study estimates against a measure of study size or precision used to explore patterns such as asymmetry.

examples.en: The funnel plot places fictional study estimates against their precision in the classroom review example.
examples.zh: 课堂综述示例的「漏斗图」将虚构研究估计值与相应精度对照绘制。

examples.en: We discussed why asymmetry in a funnel plot can have more than one explanation in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们讨论了为什么「漏斗图」的不对称性可能有多种解释。

words.enDefinition: A combined effect estimate calculated from studies included together in a statistical synthesis.

examples.en: The pooled effect estimate appears below the individual fictional study estimates in the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 课堂图将「合并效应估计值」列在各项虚构研究估计值的下方。

examples.en: We checked which studies contributed to the pooled effect estimate before describing it in words.
examples.zh: 我们先核对哪些研究纳入「合并效应估计值」，再用文字描述它。

collocations: uncertainty around a pooled effect estimate

words.enDefinition: A meta-analysis model that assumes included studies estimate one common underlying effect.

examples.en: The fixed-effect meta-analysis treats the fictional studies as estimating one underlying effect in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习的「固定效应荟萃分析」认为各虚构研究估计的是同一个潜在真实效应。

examples.en: We examined the common effect assumption before reading the fixed-effect meta-analysis estimate in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先核对共同效应假设，再读「固定效应荟萃分析」的估计。

words.enDefinition: A meta-analysis model that allows underlying true effects to vary across studies and estimates their average.

examples.en: The random-effects meta-analysis allows the fictional studies to have different underlying effects in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例的「随机效应荟萃分析」允许各虚构研究具有不同的真实效应。

examples.en: We interpreted the random-effects meta-analysis estimate as an average across the studied settings in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将「随机效应荟萃分析」的估计解释为各研究场景的平均效应。

words.enDefinition: A lack of close match between the available evidence and the population, comparison, or outcome in the question of interest.

examples.en: The indirectness of evidence arises because the fictional studies measured a different outcome from the question's target.
examples.zh: 各虚构研究测量的结局与研究问题关注的结局不同，因此存在「证据间接性」。

examples.en: We noted indirectness of evidence before comparing two outcomes in the classroom summary table.
examples.zh: 我们先注明「证据间接性」，再对比课堂汇总表中的两项结局。

words.enDefinition: Uncertainty in an effect estimate large enough that meaningfully different conclusions remain compatible with the data.

examples.en: The imprecision of evidence is apparent because the fictional interval spans several meaningfully different possibilities in class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构区间同时包含实际意义明显不同的可能值，因此体现了「证据不精确性」。

examples.en: We considered imprecision of evidence while comparing intervals for two simulated outcomes on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 比较练习中两项模拟结局的区间时，我们考虑了「证据不精确性」。

words.enDefinition: The extent to which evidence is relevant to a specified population, setting, or decision context.

examples.en: The applicability of evidence depends on whether the fictional study setting matches the one in the question.
examples.zh: 「证据适用性」取决于虚构研究的场景是否与问题中的场景相匹配。

examples.en: We discussed applicability of evidence after reading the participant characteristics in the classroom review.
examples.zh: 我们阅读课堂综述里的参与者特征后，讨论了「证据适用性」。

words.enDefinition: The smallest difference in an outcome that is judged meaningful to patients or for a stated clinical context.

examples.en: The minimal clinically important difference is listed as a fictional benchmark beside the classroom scores.
examples.zh: 「最小临床重要差异」作为虚构基准列在课堂评分旁。

examples.en: We compared the estimated change with the minimal clinically important difference stated for the example.
examples.zh: 我们将变化估计值与示例指定的「最小临床重要差异」作比较。

collocations: estimate a minimal clinically important difference
specify a minimal clinically important difference
compare with a minimal clinically important difference

words.zhGloss: 涉及人类参与者的研究
words.enDefinition: A research category involving living people through interaction or intervention, or using their identifiable private information under relevant definitions.
acceptedZhAnswers: 涉及人类参与者的研究

examples.en: The worksheet classifies the fictional survey as human subjects research because researchers interact with living participants.
examples.zh: 练习将这项虚构调查归为「涉及人类参与者的研究」，因为研究人员与在世参与者互动。

examples.en: We discussed human subjects research while reading an example scope statement for the fictional follow-up study.
examples.zh: 阅读虚构随访研究的范围说明示例时，我们讨论了「涉及人类参与者的研究」。

words.enDefinition: An independent body that reviews research involving people for ethical acceptability and participant safeguards.

examples.en: The research ethics committee is identified at the end of the fictional study's methods section.
examples.zh: 虚构研究的方法部分末尾写明了「研究伦理委员会」。

examples.en: We located the research ethics committee statement before reading the model participant information sheet in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先找到有关「研究伦理委员会」的声明，再阅读参与者信息说明示例。

collocations: review by a research ethics committee
approval from a research ethics committee

words.enDefinition: A formal favourable decision from the relevant ethics review body about a specified research proposal.

examples.en: The fictional report states the research ethics approval reference beside its description of the study setting.
examples.zh: 虚构报告在研究场景描述旁列出「研究伦理批准」编号。

examples.en: We checked what the research ethics approval covered before reading the fictional follow-up results in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先核查「研究伦理批准」涵盖哪些内容，再读虚构随访结果。

words.enDefinition: An affirmative agreement to take part in research by someone who cannot provide full consent under the applicable framework.

examples.en: The fictional information sheet describes participant assent in plain language suitable for the classroom ethics example.
examples.zh: 虚构信息说明用平实语言描述「参与者赞同」，适合课堂伦理示例。

examples.en: We discussed participant assent and the separate permission described in the model study information sheet.
examples.zh: 我们讨论「参与者赞同」以及研究信息说明示例中另行提到的许可。

words.enDefinition: A participant's decision to stop taking part in some or all aspects of a study.

examples.en: The fictional information sheet explains withdrawal from a study in a separate section for participants.
examples.zh: 虚构信息说明有一个单独面向参与者的部分，解释「退出研究」。

examples.en: We read how withdrawal from a study was recorded in the classroom flow chart for participants.
examples.zh: 我们查看课堂参与者流程图如何记录「退出研究」。

collocations: information about withdrawal from a study

words.enDefinition: Protection of identifiable participant information in how a study handles, shares, and reports records.

examples.en: The classroom report describes participant confidentiality without showing any individual identities in the synthetic results table.
examples.zh: 课堂报告说明「参与者信息保密」，合成结果表中没有展示任何个体身份。

examples.en: We read the participant confidentiality statement before discussing which fictional records could appear in the report.
examples.zh: 我们先读「参与者信息保密」声明，再讨论报告中可以展示哪些虚构记录。

words.zhGloss: 数据与安全监察委员会
words.enDefinition: An independent group that reviews accumulating study information and advises on a trial's conduct and participant safety.
acceptedZhAnswers: 数据与安全监察委员会

examples.en: The data and safety monitoring board appears on the oversight chart for the fictional trial.
examples.zh: 虚构试验的监督图上列出了「数据与安全监察委员会」。

examples.en: We distinguished the data and safety monitoring board from the committee that reviews research ethics in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分「数据与安全监察委员会」与审查研究伦理的委员会。

collocations: independent data and safety monitoring board
report from a data and safety monitoring board
remit of a data and safety monitoring board

words.enDefinition: An unfavourable medical occurrence in a study participant, without requiring a causal link to the intervention.

examples.en: The fictional study table lists each adverse event separately from judgements about its possible cause.
examples.zh: 虚构研究表将各「不良事件」与对可能原因的判断分开列出。

examples.en: We checked the denominator for the adverse event counts reported in each group of the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核对练习中报告各组「不良事件」计数所用的分母。

words.enDefinition: An adverse event that meets a specified seriousness criterion based on its outcome or consequences.

examples.en: The serious adverse event category is defined separately from symptom intensity in the fictional report.
examples.zh: 虚构报告将「严重不良事件」类别与症状强度分别定义。

examples.en: We read the serious adverse event definition before comparing the two example report tables in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先读「严重不良事件」的定义，再比较两张示例报告表。

words.enDefinition: A specified rule for classifying an adverse event by its outcome or consequences rather than by intensity alone.

examples.en: The seriousness criterion is listed beside the event categories in the fictional study's reporting guide.
examples.zh: 虚构研究的报告指南在事件类别旁列出「严重性判定标准」。

examples.en: We checked which seriousness criterion the simulated event category illustrates in the classroom report.
examples.zh: 我们核对课堂报告的模拟事件类别说明的是哪项「严重性判定标准」。

collocations: apply a seriousness criterion in a report

words.enDefinition: Recording key details of a trial in a publicly accessible registry, including its planned design and outcomes.

examples.en: The trial registration record gives the planned primary outcome for the fictional study used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构研究的「试验登记」记录列出预定主要结局。

examples.en: We checked the trial registration date against the dates in the classroom study timeline.
examples.zh: 我们将「试验登记」日期与课堂研究时间线中的日期核对。

words.enDefinition: A database that provides searchable records of trials and their declared study details.

examples.en: The trial registry entry contains the design summary for the fictional diary study used in class.
examples.zh: 「试验注册平台」条目包含课堂虚构日志研究的设计摘要。

examples.en: We compared the trial registry entry with the outcome descriptions in the example report.
examples.zh: 我们将「试验注册平台」条目与示例报告中的结局描述作比较。

words.enDefinition: A unique label used to link a trial with its registry record or other documentation.

examples.en: The trial identifier matches on the fictional registry entry and the classroom results table.
examples.zh: 虚构登记条目和课堂结果表的「试验识别编号」一致。

examples.en: We copied the trial identifier from the model report to locate its matching registry record.
examples.zh: 我们从报告示例抄下「试验识别编号」，以找到对应的登记记录。

words.enDefinition: A written plan describing a study's objectives, design, eligibility, outcomes, and intended methods.

examples.en: The study protocol lists the planned follow-up period for the fictional activity diary study in class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构活动日志研究的「研究方案」列出预定随访期。

examples.en: We compared the study protocol with the results paper to see how the outcome was described.
examples.zh: 我们将「研究方案」与结果论文比较，查看其中如何描述该结局。

words.enDefinition: A documented change to the approved or recorded plan for a study.

examples.en: The protocol amendment changes the stated assessment date in the fictional classroom version of the study.
examples.zh: 「方案修订」更改了课堂虚构版研究所列的评估日期。

examples.en: We checked the date of the protocol amendment before comparing the two versions of the plan.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「方案修订」日期，再比较两个版本的计划。

words.enDefinition: An instance in which study conduct differs from the stated protocol.

examples.en: The protocol deviation is recorded when a fictional assessment falls outside the scheduled time window.
examples.zh: 虚构评估落在预定时间窗外时，研究记录了「方案偏离」。

examples.en: We distinguished a protocol deviation from an approved change to the written plan in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分了「方案偏离」与对书面计划作出的获批更改。

words.enDefinition: A document specifying how study data and outcomes will be analysed and reported.

examples.en: The statistical analysis plan states how the fictional report will summarise the main outcome in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的「统计分析计划」说明虚构报告将怎样汇总主要结局。

examples.en: We checked the statistical analysis plan before interpreting the comparisons in the example results table.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「统计分析计划」，再解读示例结果表中的各项比较。

words.enDefinition: An analysis defined in the recorded study plan before examination of the relevant results.

examples.en: The prespecified analysis uses the groups and comparison listed in the fictional plan for class.
examples.zh: 「预先设定的分析」采用课堂虚构方案列出的组别与比较。

examples.en: We matched the prespecified analysis to its description before reading the additional classroom results.
examples.zh: 我们先将「预先设定的分析」与其描述对应起来，再读课堂的补充结果。

words.enDefinition: An analysis formulated after the relevant data or results have been examined.

examples.en: The report labels a post hoc analysis that followed inspection of the fictional subgroup results.
examples.zh: 报告把查看虚构亚组结果之后发起的一项分析标为「事后分析」。

examples.en: We distinguished the post hoc analysis from the main comparison named in the written plan.
examples.zh: 我们区分「事后分析」与书面方案指定的主要比较。

words.enDefinition: An analysis that compares all randomized participants in their originally assigned groups, regardless of adherence, with prespecified handling of unavailable outcomes.

examples.en: The intention-to-treat analysis keeps each fictional participant in the group originally assigned on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中的「意向治疗分析」将各虚构参与者保留在原分配组。

examples.en: We checked the original group labels before reading the intention-to-treat analysis results in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先核对原分配组标签，再看「意向治疗分析」的结果。

words.enDefinition: An analysis targeting the effect under adherence to the study protocol, under stated definitions and assumptions.

examples.en: The per-protocol analysis applies the adherence criteria explained in the fictional report used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构报告说明了依从条件，「符合方案分析」应用这些条件。

examples.en: We checked the assumptions of the per-protocol analysis before comparing it with the main estimate.
examples.zh: 我们先核查「符合方案分析」的假设，再把其结果与主要估计比较。

words.enDefinition: An analysis grouping participants by the intervention they actually received, regardless of original assignment.

examples.en: The as-treated analysis groups the fictional participants by the diary format they used during follow-up.
examples.zh: 「按实际干预分析」按虚构参与者随访期间实际使用的日志版式分组。

examples.en: We compared the as-treated analysis with the table organised by original assignment in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「按实际干预分析」与按原分配组整理的表格作比较。

words.enDefinition: The extent to which a study intervention is delivered as intended in the study plan.

examples.en: The intervention fidelity section describes whether the fictional reminder schedule was delivered as planned in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的「干预实施忠实度」部分说明虚构提醒安排是否按计划实施。

examples.en: We read the intervention fidelity notes before comparing findings across the fictional sites in the study.
examples.zh: 比较研究中各虚构地点的发现之前，我们先读了「干预实施忠实度」说明。

words.enDefinition: A diagram showing how many people enter, progress through, and are included in a trial's analysis.

examples.en: The participant flow diagram shows the fictional group counts from initial recruitment to the analysis table.
examples.zh: 「参与者流程图」展示虚构各组从最初招募到纳入分析表的人数。

examples.en: We used the participant flow diagram to locate where the two classroom group totals changed.
examples.zh: 我们用「参与者流程图」找出课堂两组人数在哪个阶段发生变化。

collocations: counts in a participant flow diagram

words.enDefinition: A reporting guideline with a checklist and participant flow diagram for completed randomised trials.

examples.en: CONSORT 2025 is named beside the fictional trial report's checklist in the classroom reading exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂阅读练习在虚构试验报告的清单旁注明「CONSORT 2025 报告规范」。

examples.en: We consulted CONSORT 2025 to identify which details the sample randomised trial report should describe.
examples.zh: 我们查阅「CONSORT 2025 报告规范」，确认随机试验报告示例应描述哪些细节。

words.enDefinition: A reporting guideline specifying essential items for protocols of randomised trials.

examples.en: SPIRIT 2025 is cited in the model protocol provided for the classroom trial reading exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂试验阅读练习提供的方案示例中，引用了「SPIRIT 2025 方案报告规范」。

examples.en: We used SPIRIT 2025 to distinguish a documented protocol from the separate final trial report.
examples.zh: 我们借助「SPIRIT 2025 方案报告规范」区分成文方案与另行编写的试验结果报告。

words.enDefinition: A reporting guideline with checklists and flow diagram templates for systematic reviews.

examples.en: PRISMA 2020 is listed next to the review checklist on the classroom evidence reading worksheet.
examples.zh: 课堂证据研读的练习纸在综述清单旁列有「PRISMA 2020 报告规范」。

examples.en: We used PRISMA 2020 while reading how the fictional review documented its selection of studies.
examples.zh: 我们借助「PRISMA 2020 报告规范」，阅读虚构综述如何记录研究选择过程。

words.enDefinition: A review diagram documenting how records progress from identification to inclusion, with counts and exclusions at relevant stages.

examples.en: The study selection flow diagram lists counts of fictional records at successive stages in the review.
examples.zh: 「研究选择流程图」列出虚构记录在综述各连续阶段的数量。

examples.en: We located the exclusions on the study selection flow diagram before reading the classroom synthesis.
examples.zh: 我们先在「研究选择流程图」上找到被排除记录的情况，再读课堂综合结果。

collocations: read a study selection flow diagram
counts in a study selection flow diagram
exclusions in a study selection flow diagram

words.enDefinition: Reporting only some measured outcomes or results depending on their findings.

examples.en: The classroom review considers selective outcome reporting when the fictional results omit a prespecified outcome.
examples.zh: 虚构结果漏掉一个预先设定的结局时，课堂综述考虑「选择性结局报告」。

examples.en: We compared the fictional plan and report to discuss the possibility of selective outcome reporting.
examples.zh: 我们把虚构方案与报告作比较，讨论「选择性结局报告」的可能性。

words.enDefinition: Making study results publicly available, for example in a registry or report.

examples.en: The trial results disclosure includes a summary table for each group in the fictional classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构示例的「试验结果公开」材料包含各组的汇总表。

examples.en: We located trial results disclosure separately from the original registration record in the simulated example.
examples.zh: 在模拟示例中，我们先后找到「试验结果公开」材料和原始登记记录。

words.enDefinition: A statement describing the sponsor's involvement in a study's design, conduct, analysis, or reporting.

examples.en: The sponsor role statement describes whether the fictional funder took part in analysing the study data.
examples.zh: 「申办方角色说明」交代虚构资助方是否参与研究数据的分析。

examples.en: We read the sponsor role statement before discussing the independence of the fictional report in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先读「申办方角色说明」，再讨论虚构报告的独立性。

collocations: sponsor role statement in a report

words.enDefinition: A report section explaining how supporting study data can be accessed or why access is limited.

examples.en: The data availability statement explains which synthetic tables accompany the classroom study report for readers.
examples.zh: 「数据可用性声明」向读者说明课堂研究报告随附哪些合成表格。

examples.en: We checked the data availability statement before looking for the fictional study's supporting data summary.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「数据可用性声明」，再找虚构研究的支持数据摘要。

collocations: restrictions in a data availability statement

words.enDefinition: A checklist or structured set of recommendations about information to include in a research report.

examples.en: The reporting guideline helps readers check whether the fictional trial report describes its main study methods.
examples.zh: 「报告规范」帮助读者核查虚构试验报告是否描述了主要研究方法。

examples.en: We distinguished a reporting guideline from a judgement about bias in the classroom review example.
examples.zh: 在课堂综述示例中，我们将「报告规范」与对偏倚的判断区分开。
